name: Architecture Decision Record (MADR)
description: A MADR-format decision record: title, status, date, context, decision, consequences, alternatives considered. ADRs are immutable once accepted; a change is a new ADR that supersedes the old one.

placeholders.name: title
placeholders.description: Imperative, specific: what was decided, not the topic.
placeholders.example: Add a template class for rendered documents

placeholders.name: status
placeholders.description: proposed, accepted, deprecated, or superseded by NNNN.

placeholders.name: date
placeholders.description: ISO-8601 date the decision was recorded.

placeholders.name: relations
placeholders.description: Optional bullet lines: 'Supersedes NNNN', 'Builds on NNNN'.

placeholders.name: context
placeholders.description: The forces at play: the problem, constraints, measured facts. Cite sources for anything not obvious.
placeholders.example: Agents asked to write an ADR had no skeleton to fill…

placeholders.name: decision
placeholders.description: What was decided, stated as a decision, with the reasoning that carried it.
placeholders.example: Add template-v1 with body, placeholders, and example…

placeholders.name: consequences
placeholders.description: What becomes easier, what becomes harder, what must follow. Include the negative ones.
placeholders.example: Nine classes instead of eight; the site nav grows…

placeholders.name: alternatives
placeholders.description: Each alternative with why it was rejected. Include 'do nothing' when it was a real option.
placeholders.example: Keep templates as prompt/output-schema atoms — rejected because…

example:
# 0004. Add a template class for rendered documents

- Status: proposed
- Date: 2026-09-03
- Builds on: 0001, 0002

## Context

An agent told to write an ADR, runbook, or handoff had no skeleton to fill; two prompt atoms described the shapes in prose.

## Decision

Add template-v1: a document skeleton with typed placeholders and one rendered example. Rendering is a distinct runtime action from injecting text, which is the taxonomy's test for a class.

## Consequences

Nine classes. The two prose-shaped prompts migrate. Blank atom files for authoring are not templates; they live in schemas/examples/.

## Alternatives considered

- Keep describing document shapes as prompt/output-schema atoms. Rejected: a description is not a skeleton a runtime can fill.
- Put templates in doc-atoms. Rejected: they are consumed by AI runtimes, which is this catalog's scope.
rules: Never edit an accepted ADR; write a new one that supersedes it.
Every non-trivial decision gets an ADR before the conversation that made it ends.
Consequences must include the negative ones.

provenance.author: convergent-systems-co
provenance.notes: MADR field set as required by the AI Constitution §4.9.1 (title, status, context, decision, consequences, alternatives).
